crossRefs.note: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.
They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.
Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came, and were baptized;
“ ‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against…
Joshua said to Achan, “My son, please give glory to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and make confession to him. Tell me now…
I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you…
He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
Peter said to them, “Repent, and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of…
Many also of those who had believed came, confessing, and declaring their deeds.
If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

translations.web: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.
translations.bsb: People went out to him from all of Jerusalem and the countryside of Judea. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
translations.kjv: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
translations.asv: And there went out unto him all the country of Judaea, and all they of Jerusalem; And they were baptized of him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.
